artwork: Native SwiftUI vector paths reproduce the approved Lift silhouette and small Panel football; no generated raster cutout is used.
appearance: Dynamic ivory/charcoal launch background; the splash follows the existing app Light/Dark/System setting, with matching lime halo and light/dark mark.
timing: 600 ms presentation, then a 220 ms opacity transition. Reduce Motion removes the fade. State is retained at the root across navigation and background/foreground transitions.
review_mode: Debug only: --splash-preview -kicklab.appearance dark (or light). Omit --splash-preview for normal dismissal.
native_launch: LaunchScreen.storyboard provides an adaptive background before SwiftUI is ready. The branded splash is an in-app opening view.

validation.visual: Light and dark reviewed on iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5

excluded_artwork_experiment.outcome: Excluded: transparent cutout showed rough matte edges. Native vector drawing used instead.
